stories.title: Trump orders Lake Ontario renamed Lake America in Canada dispute
new_facts: Trump signed executive order renaming Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' effective immediately.
Trump quoted saying he wants to seize an ocean next, after the gulf and lake.
Order directs Interior Department to update the Geographic Names Information System.
Notes the order has no legal effect outside the United States.
Trump quoted: 'We're going to be changing the name of Lake Ontario effective immediately.'
Trump quoted blaming Canada for 'ripping us off' on trade as motive for the renaming.
stories.line: Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America, escalating a trade dispute with Canada.

stories.title: Abbott pauses Texas data center approvals
new_facts: Texas Gov. Abbott ordered a pause on data center approvals, affecting ~300 large data centers.
stories.line: Texas governor pauses new data center approvals as power demand from AI infrastructure strains the grid.

stories.title: NASA launches Roman telescope after Trump's failed cancellation bid
new_facts: NASA's Roman telescope, a multi-billion dollar dark matter/energy probe, set to launch Sunday.
Private rescue of NASA's Swift telescope failed; it will crash back to Earth soon.
Trump's leaked budget proposal last year sought to cancel the Roman telescope before its launch.
stories.line: NASA launches the Roman telescope Sunday to study dark matter and dark energy, after Trump's attempt to cancel it last year; separately, the aging Swift telescope faces uncontrolled reentry.

stories.title: Salesforce stock jumps on AI optimism and Anthropic holdings
new_facts: Anthropic outlines framework for how AI agents should navigate the physical world, citing risks in automating research/manufacturing.
Salesforce stock jumps 20% on Q2 earnings beat and expanded AI partnership with Anthropic.
Salesforce's Anthropic equity stake produced an investment gain that boosted quarterly profit.
stories.line: Salesforce stock surges on AI optimism; company has stake in Anthropic, which is developing AI agents for physical tasks.

stories.title: Glacial lake burst in Nepal kills hundreds; rescuers search for missing foreigners
new_facts: New story: ~90 Americans unaccounted for after Nepal-Tibet flash floods
Death toll now 389; revised figure of 63 Americans missing
Aid scramble underway; warning that a glacial lake formed by the flood risks bursting
Scientists say a glacier chunk broke off and dammed a river, causing the flood
360 confirmed dead, more than 1,300 people still missing
Death toll now 392; dozens of Australians reported among missing
USGS attributes flood to glacial collapse in Langtang National Park at 8:37am, ~35 miles north of Kathmandu
Nepali government minister warns state was unprepared for disaster of this magnitude; families describe being cut off from Kathmandu
stories.line: A glacial lake burst in Nepal and Tibet killed hundreds; rescue efforts ongoing with Americans and other foreigners among the missing.

stories.title: UEFA pursues criminal case against Infantino over World Cup sale plan
new_facts: First report UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against Infantino over failed World Cup investor plan.
Specifies complaint to be filed in Swiss courts alleging financial mismanagement.
Names Joshua Kushner's Thrive Capital, $4.2bn deal price, and quotes UEFA lawyers calling it fraudulently off-market.
UEFA seeking documents from Kushner's investment firm.
UEFA asked a US court for FIFA documents and has suspended a boycott threat.
States UEFA pursuing criminal proceedings against both FIFA and Infantino, not just Infantino personally.
Frames UEFA's action as part of a broader campaign to oust Infantino as FIFA president.
Names the plan as the 'Fifa Forward Enterprise' plan and details separate US applications for documents on its conception.
Saudi Arabia's football federation publicly backs Infantino amid the FIFA crisis.
stories.line: UEFA is pursuing criminal charges against FIFA president Infantino over a failed World Cup sale scheme, while support fractures among member nations.

stories.title: Jury deliberating in Lindsay Clancy infanticide trial
new_facts: Names defense attorney Kevin Reddington and prosecutor Jennifer Sprague delivering closing arguments Thursday
Clancy's age given as 36; jury has begun deliberations
Reddington's closing quote: Clancy was a 'damn good mother' who 'did nothing wrong'
Prosecutors allege Clancy faked a suicide attempt that left her paralyzed from the waist down
Defense argument now includes claim Clancy was overmedicated in addition to postpartum psychosis
Reports protests outside the courthouse amid online debate over the case
Prosecutor's closing quote accuses Clancy of 'extreme atrocity and cruelty'
Prosecution rebuttal quote: 'This wasn't a woman suffering from a lack of care' or 'a lack of resources'; defense blamed medical system
stories.line: Jury deliberating in trial of Massachusetts woman accused of killing her three children; defense argued postpartum psychosis, prosecution argued murder.
